zh-CN.title: 这是苦圣谛
zh-CN.subtitle: 《转法轮经》中的四圣谛言说
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这一短句把佛教教法放回鹿野苑初转法轮的经文语境，而不是抽离成一条现代格言。
curatorialDescription: 原文、版本、说话者归属和鹿野苑事件分别建模；佛陀的言说关系标记为经由传述者保存。
zh-CN.researchNote: 原典使用巴利语数字版本作为研究入口；汉译、异本和更完整段落将在后续校勘批次补齐。

interpretation.en: This is the noble truth of suffering.

en.title: This is the noble truth of suffering
en.subtitle: A Four Noble Truths saying in the Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta
en.shortSummary: The short line keeps Buddhist teaching within the textual setting of the first turning at Sarnath rather than turning it into a context-free modern maxim.
curatorialDescription: Original text, version, speaker attribution and the Sarnath event are modelled separately; the Buddha's saying is marked as preserved through transmission.
en.researchNote: The Pāli digital edition is the research entry point. Chinese translations, parallels and a fuller passage will be added in a later textual-review batch.

profile.translationEn: This is the noble truth of suffering.

note.zh-CN: 当前巴利语段落的英译字段使用 suffering；同一经文的 Thanissaro 英译版本使用 stress。本条只记录译者措辞差异，不把它当作巴利语底本异文或唯一释义。
note.en: The current Pāli passage uses suffering in its English field; the Thanissaro English witness uses stress. This records a translator-wording difference, not a manuscript variant or a single authorised interpretation of the Pāli.
